body: make install fixed a real go.work bug (every target silently broken, needed GOWORK=off) and now installs to ~/.local/bin matching emily.cli/IDUNA CLI convention. Ctrl+Alt+I hotkey verified live via Xvfb+XTest+screenshot -- real ssh connection attempt to iduna.farthq.com confirmed in the captured frame. First README.md this repo has had. Commit d9cce1a.
title: Installable via make install (~/.local/bin) + Ctrl+Alt+I SSH-to-IDUNA hotkey, both live-verified
